hook: Your car rolls uphill here with the engine off.
title: Your Car Rolls Uphill in Ladakh
description:
At Magnetic Hill near Leh in Ladakh, a car in neutral seems to roll uphill. It is a gravity-hill illusion: the surrounding land hides the horizon, so a downhill slope looks like an uphill one. Places That Shouldn't Exist, part of our geography series.

#Shorts #Ladakh #MagneticHill
